Fluffy Spelt Pancakes
By: Michelle
Published: Saturday, March 27, 2010 - 2:31pm

Ingredients




1 cup organic spelt flour
1/4 cup wheat bran
1 tablespoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/4 teaspoon salt
1 tablespoon honey
1 egg
1 cup soy milk or low fat milk
1 tablespoon melted butter
2 teaspoons vanilla extract

Preparation

1 Sift the below ingredients into a big bowl: 2 Cup organic spelt flour 3 Cup wheat bran 4 Tbs baking powder 5 Tsp baking soda 6 Tsp salt 7 Add in 1 egg, 1 cup soy milk or low fat milk, 1 tbs melted butter, honey and 2 tsp vanilla extract into the dry ingredients. 8 Heat dry flat non-stick pan, no need to oil it. 9 Spoon 1/4 cup batter. A min or two on each side.
